title: 6D ATS-1R Flow Red

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Serving closed-circuit and supersport riders, the 6D Helmets 6D ATS-1R Flow Red is born on the race grid to conquer high-speed turbulence. Featuring a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber architecture at a featherweight 1264g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~91 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Carbon road race helmet with ODS technology for multi-directional impact.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for a snug, track-focused fit with minimal cheek pad volume to reduce drag; requires precise sizing as it runs slightly small compared to DOT equivalents. Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the 6D Helmets 6D ATS-1R Flow Red: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: 6D Helmets 6D ATS-1R Flow Red: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the 6D Helmets 6D ATS-1R Flow Red. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in 6D Helmets's Track / Race lineup, the 6D ATS-1R Flow Red brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The 6D Helmets 6D ATS-1R Flow Red represents 6D Helmets's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~91 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the 6D Helmets 6D ATS-1R Flow Red delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
